summary: Frontend-only regression test of client-side event dedup fix in /app/frontend/src/lib/tracker.js. All 9 test cases from review request PASSED. StrictMode double-invoke no longer produces duplicate events, and 2.5s dedup window works as designed. Heartbeats and pageviews are correctly NOT deduped against each other (separate keys).
verified_scenarios: Hard-load /quem-somos → exactly 1 pageview (was 2 with StrictMode before fix)
whatsapp_click clicked again after 2.7s → 1 more event recorded (total=2). Timestamps observed: 17.64s and 21.37s (delta ~3.73s > DEDUPE_MS=2500ms)
pageview and heartbeat both fire on mount with same page (keys differ 'pageview|/home' vs 'heartbeat|/home') — no cross-dedup, both recorded
Admin /api/admin/activity feed continues returning events with correct timestamps and session_ids
session_id persists across SPA navigation via sessionStorage
critical_code_review_comments: recent Map has no cleanup/eviction — grows unbounded over a long session (minor memory leak). Consider periodic pruning of entries older than DEDUPE_MS. Not blocking.

Dedup key is (type|page) — if two truly distinct meaningful clicks happen on same page within 2.5s (e.g. two rapid whatsapp_click for different phone numbers), the second is silently dropped. Acceptable trade-off for current UX.
seed_data_creation: None. Test used ephemeral session_ids generated by app.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fix confirmed working end-to-end. tracker.js dedup Map correctly blocks StrictMode duplicates. No further action needed on this bug.
